title: Regional study director, latam
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Regional study director, latam em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Crinetics is a pharmaceutical company headquartered in San Diego, California, with a growing presence in Latin America, including an office in Brazil. We are developing much-needed therapies for people with endocrine diseases and endocrine-related tumors. We were founded by a dedicated team of scientists with the simple belief that better therapies developed from rigorous innovation can lead to better lives. Our work continues to make a real difference in the lives of patients. We have a prolific discovery engine and a robust preclinical and clinical development pipeline. We are driven by science with a patient-centric and team-oriented culture. Crinetics is known for its inclusive workplace culture. This is an exciting time to join Crinetics as we expand our operations in Latin America and shape our organization into the world's premier fully integrated endocrine company from discovery to patients. Join our team as we transform the lives of others.

Position Summary:

Please note, the candidate for this role will need to be located in Brazil.

The Regional Study Director, LATAM is responsible for managing the execution of clinical studies and data collection within the LATAM region. The incumbent will serve as a regional clinical study lead who oversees the review, monitoring, and adherence to clinical protocols, as well as managing and building relationships with clinical sites in LATAM. The Regional Study Director, LATAM may oversee other regional study leads within the region to facilitate a streamlined and quality study execution. This role will also work internally and externally with members of the cross-functional study team.

Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities:

These may include but are not limited to:

Provide oversight of clinical research studies for LATAM. Manage and build relationships with clinical research sites in LATAM. May oversee the work of other regional study leads within LATAM. Provide operational and strategic input into study documents such as synopsis, protocol, ICF, CRFs, CRF Completion Guidelines, Study Execution Plans, Clinical Data Review Plan, Clinical Database edit specifications, Clinical Study Report (CSR) development, etc. Oversight of all regional vendors and activities including CROs. Oversee regional start up activities including site selection, enrollment projections and activities driving site activation. Develop region specific the subject recruitment/retention strategy and related initiatives. Oversight of regional TMF ongoing quality review, and final reconciliation of study documents including review of site regulatory documents/packages and obtaining of appropriate site insurance, and/or supervision of team members performing these activities. Development of training materials for study team, investigational sites, and vendors. Proactive management of information sharing with key stakeholders using standardized reports and other mechanisms. Assure clinical studies are compliant with GDPR, ICH/GCP and other regulations as appropriate. Outline regional activation hurdles for team. Participate in RFP development and prepare bid templates to facilitate selection of the CROs/vendors, and/or collaboration/supervision with team members performing these activities. Collaborate with counsel to negotiate and draft research contracts and agreements with CROs/vendors and clinical study sites, as needed. Acts as liaison with Regulatory Affairs to assure adherence to GDPR, GCPs; maintenance of SOPs; and assure site and CRO/vendor audits are completed. Perform regional risk management and implement mitigations. Identify potential study issues and recommend and implement solutions or corrective actions as needed. Create realistic plans that clearly define goals, milestones, responsibilities, and results. Maintain focus on strategic objectives while accomplishing operational goals. Make timely, data-driven decisions. Manage daily activities, assign tasks, goals, and development of direct reports. Other duties as assigned.

Required Education and Experience:

Bachelor's degree required, preferably in scientific discipline. An equivalent combination of relevant education and applicable job experience may be considered. 12 years of prior clinical operations experience preferably with CRO/small biotech experience and approximately 8 years of experience in a supervisory role. Must be able to travel 25-50% of time, may be higher in accordance with project requirements. Computer skills should include proficiency with Microsoft Office suite of software, electronic TMF systems, IXRS and EDC systems. Excellent understanding of drug development process. Experience in clinical trial supply management. Able to make appropriate decisions to move the project(s) forward. Effective verbal and written communication skills. Data flow from sites to data processing, review, and resolution. Analysis and report generation. Knowledge of local regulatory requirements. Ability to handle multiple tasks to meet deadlines in a dynamic environment is essential. Study initiation procedures. Ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action

Travel:

You may be required to travel for up to 25-50% of your time.

title: English teacher
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para English teacher em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.

If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!

In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:

Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.

Minimum Requirements:

Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

Who we are:

Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

description:

About Freight Hero

Freight Hero is an AI-native services company built to support the freight brokerage industry, which is in dire need of it. Robin, our autonomous AI agent, handles back-office work end to end. Our Heroes, a sharp human-in-the-loop team, catch the edge cases. Brokers pay us per load, see ROI in weeks, and reassign or eliminate the teams they used to rent.

We are backed by incredible investors, including Andrew Ng's AI Fund and supply chain specialists Dynamo Ventures.

The thesis is proven. What is next is growth, and that means building a team of incredible people around us to push the company to the next level. The product is real, the customers are real, the revenue is real, and joining now means shaping how this company runs.

About the Role

This is a senior full‐stack engineering role focused on building and scaling the core Freight Hero platform. You will work across backend services, integrations, internal tools, and customer-facing features, primarily using Node.js, Type Script, React, and AWS.

You won't be inheriting a legacy monolith. You'll be contributing to a modern, event‐driven, AI‐powered system and helping us scale it as customer adoption accelerates.

You'll collaborate closely with product, AI, and customer teams to translate real operational workflows into robust, reliable software. As the team grows, you'll have opportunities to mentor others, influence architecture, and shape engineering best practices.

What Success Looks Like

A successful engineer in this role:

Builds scalable, reliable services in Node.js/Type Script that integrate deeply with customer systems. Designs and maintains AWS‐native infrastructure that is observable, secure, and cost‐efficient. Works cross‐functionally to understand customer workflows and translate them into technical solutions. Ships high‐quality features quickly while maintaining engineering excellence. Identifies opportunities to automate, optimize, and expand the platform. Contributes to a culture of ownership, clarity, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities:

Full Stack Engineering

Build backend services, APIs, and workflow engines using Node.js + Type Script. Contribute to frontend components when needed using React + Vue JS. Implement robust testing, observability, and CI/CD practices.

AWS native Architecture

Design and maintain cloud infrastructure using AWS services such as Lambda, RDS, Dynamo DB, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, and more. Ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost‐optimized.

Systems Integration

Build integrations with TMS platforms, carrier systems, and customer‐specific tools.

title: Portuguese language specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Portuguese language specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Position Overview:

As a Gen AI Data Annotation Analyst, you will play a critical role in developing high-quality datasets that power the next generation of Large Language Models (LLMs). You will evaluate, generate, and refine multi-modal data (text, image, or video) to ensure AI outputs are accurate, safe, and culturally resonant for the Portuguese market.

Key Responsibilities

Multi-Modal Annotation: Label and categorize high-quality training data across text, image, and video formats with surgical precision. Content Generation: Draft grammatically flawless, creative, and factually accurate text in both Portuguese and English, adapting tone and style for specific project needs. Edge-Case Resolution: Apply logical reasoning to resolve ambiguous data scenarios where guidelines may not explicitly cover a specific nuance. Continuous Feedback: Identify and report bugs within internal annotation tools and suggest workflow optimizations. Cross-Functional Sync: Collaborate with Leads and Project Managers to calibrate on quality benchmarks and project pivots.

System Requirements (Mandatory):

Full set of desktop/Laptop with Windows 11 Pro. Bring a compliant device. Windows 11 Pro (Home editions not allowed) or mac OS 12+, 8 GB RAM, 50 GB free disk. Tablets/Chromebooks/phones won't be accepted.

Network: Stable Internet connection, which should have a speed of up to 40 MBPS

Requirements:

Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification. Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in annotation tasks, linguistic data handling, or related AI/ML projects. Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms. Strong understanding of language nuances, including grammar, style, and cultural context. Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments. Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training. Familiarity with annotation projects involving sensitive or nuanced content. Prior exposure to Generative AI technologies and principles.

What We Offer:

An innovative and supportive global working environment. Opportunities for continuous learning and growth. Competitive compensation and remote working arrangements. Engagement in impactful projects at the forefront of AI technology.

Join i Merit to be part of shaping high-quality datasets powering the next generation of

Generative AI solutions. If precision, critical analysis, and innovation excite you, we encourage

you to apply!

description:

What the Associate II, Pharmacovigilance does at Worldwide

Responsible for the collection, processing, evaluation and reporting of incoming Serious Adverse Event (SAE) data according to applicable regulatory guidelines/requirements, Worldwide Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and project specific instructions. We're looking for a Creative Strategist with strong persuasive advertising and copywriting expertise to own the ideation and messaging that drives performance. You'll turn customer insights, performance data, and market awareness into high-converting creative angles, scripts, and messaging systems that scale.

title: Portuguese language specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Portuguese language specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Position Overview:

As a Gen AI Data Annotation Analyst, you will play a critical role in developing high-quality datasets that power the next generation of Large Language Models (LLMs). You will evaluate, generate, and refine multi-modal data (text, image, or video) to ensure AI outputs are accurate, safe, and culturally resonant for the Portuguese market.

Key Responsibilities

Multi-Modal Annotation: Label and categorize high-quality training data across text, image, and video formats with surgical precision. Content Generation: Draft grammatically flawless, creative, and factually accurate text in both Portuguese and English, adapting tone and style for specific project needs. Edge-Case Resolution: Apply logical reasoning to resolve ambiguous data scenarios where guidelines may not explicitly cover a specific nuance. Continuous Feedback: Identify and report bugs within internal annotation tools and suggest workflow optimizations. Cross-Functional Sync: Collaborate with Leads and Project Managers to calibrate on quality benchmarks and project pivots.

System Requirements (Mandatory):

Full set of desktop/Laptop with Windows 11 Pro. Bring a compliant device. Windows 11 Pro (Home editions not allowed) or mac OS 12+, 8 GB RAM, 50 GB free disk. Tablets/Chromebooks/phones won't be accepted.

Network: Stable Internet connection, which should have a speed of up to 40 MBPS

Requirements:

Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification. Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in annotation tasks, linguistic data handling, or related AI/ML projects. Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms. Strong understanding of language nuances, including grammar, style, and cultural context. Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments. Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training. Familiarity with annotation projects involving sensitive or nuanced content. Prior exposure to Generative AI technologies and principles.

What We Offer:

An innovative and supportive global working environment. Opportunities for continuous learning and growth. Competitive compensation and remote working arrangements. Engagement in impactful projects at the forefront of AI technology.

Join i Merit to be part of shaping high-quality datasets powering the next generation of

Generative AI solutions. If precision, critical analysis, and innovation excite you, we encourage

you to apply!

title: Gerente de vendas técnicas
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Gerente de vendas técnicas em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Technical Sales & Partnerships Manager, NIR - North America

Work Location: East Coast (USA)

Negotiable

Employment Type: CLT/PJ

Start Date Availability: Immediate upon approval

!!️ Summary of Responsibilities:

Manage and develop a sales pipeline across North America.

Prospect, qualify, and close opportunities within agribusiness and agro-industrial segments.

Sell portable NIR equipment, software, and calibration services.

Develop strategic partnerships with laboratories, universities, and research centers.

Support the development of a local validation and calibration network for the North American market.

Conduct technical assessments, product demonstrations, and validation activities for NIR solutions.

Engage with customers to identify needs, applications, and return on investment (ROI).

Structure and manage Proofs of Concept (Po Cs) and pilot projects.

Implement consultative sales strategies focused on results and technical validation.

Gather market intelligence to enhance positioning, ICP, presentations, and commercial processes.

Required Qualifications:

*Experience in technical sales, market development, or product management.

*Experience with analytical instruments, spectroscopy, agricultural technologies, animal nutrition, laboratory services, or quality control.

Strong skills in proactive prospecting, new business development, and opportunity management.

*Ability to build relationships with technical customers, laboratories, researchers, and agribusiness industry leaders.

*Interest and ability to learn about NIR, calibration, forage analysis, and feed analysis.

*Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

*Availability to travel for demonstrations, technical visits, and industry events.

*Self-driven profile with the ability to work in a startup environment and handle a high level of responsibility.

*Remote position, preferably based on the East Coast of the United States.

Preferred Qualifications:

*Experience with NIR, FT-NIR, Raman, hyperspectral imaging, portable spectrometers, feed analysis, forage analysis, dairy nutrition, silage, or PAT (Process Analytical Technology).

*Existing relationships with forage laboratories, feed laboratories, dairy nutrition consultants, Land-Grant Universities, animal nutrition companies, or agricultural extension groups.

*Experience selling through distributors, manufacturers' representatives, laboratories, or technical channel partners.

*Ability to conduct basic product demonstrations and coordinate sample testing and analysis workflows.

*Portuguese, Spanish, and English language skills.

title: Especialista em governança de dados
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Especialista em governança de dados em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Somos o Grupo Casas Bahia, com mais de 70 anos de história, realizando os sonhos de +100 milhões de brasileiros.

Aqui, somos protagonistas o tempo todo, sempre com integridade e ética em tudo o que fazemos. A paixão pela nossa gente é o que nos move, e a dedicação total ao cliente é o nosso compromisso diário. Entregamos resultados e buscamos sempre a simplicidade em tudo o que fazemos!

Buscamos um(a) Especialista em Governança de Dados para estruturar, evoluir e operacionalizar o framework de governança da nossa Plataforma de Dados. Este papel é fundamental para garantir que os dados da companhia sejam confiáveis, descobríveis, seguros e em conformidade — transformando governança de um requisito de compliance em um habilitador de valor para o negócio.

Mais do que definir políticas e padrões, este papel exige profundidade técnica em plataformas modernas de dados, visão sistêmica do ciclo de vida do dado e capacidade de implementar governança de forma prática e escalável, embarcada na esteira de desenvolvimento. O objetivo é elevar a maturidade de governança da companhia, tornando-a um diferencial competitivo sustentado por automação e cultura.

Responsabilidades

Atuar diretamente na definição, evolução e operacionalização do framework corporativo de Governança de Dados da plataforma. Definir, manter e disseminar políticas, padrões e processos relacionados à governança de dados, incluindo: Catalogação, Classificação, Qualidade de dados, Linhagem, Ciclo de vida do dado; Gestão de acessos. Estruturar e evoluir o catálogo corporativo de dados, garantindo descoberta, documentação, rastreabilidade e contexto de negócio para os ativos de dados. Implementar e governar controles de qualidade de dados, incluindo: Definição de regras; Monitoramento contínuo; Alertas e Processos de remediação. Liderar iniciativas de classificação e proteção de dados sensíveis e pessoais, assegurando conformidade com LGPD e demais regulamentações aplicáveis. Atuar com visão ponta a ponta do ecossistema de dados, compreendendo: Fluxos de dados em arquiteturas modernas (Bronze → Silver → Gold); Linhagem e gestão ativa de metadados; Controles de acesso e segregação de dados; Técnicas de mascaramento, anonimização e proteção de dados. Definir e operacionalizar papéis e responsabilidades de governança: Data Owners; Data Stewards e Custodiantes. Integrar práticas de governança à esteira de desenvolvimento de dados, automatizando controles e reduzindo fricção para os times de engenharia. Atuar em parceria com Segurança da Informação, Privacidade, Jurídico e Compliance em temas relacionados a auditoria, conformidade e resposta a incidentes. Apoiar demandas regulatórias, auditorias e requisições relacionadas a titulares de dados. Definir, acompanhar e comunicar métricas e indicadores de: Maturidade de governança; Qualidade de dados. Promover cultura orientada a dados e disseminar boas práticas de governança na organização, atuando como referência técnica no tema.

Requisitos e Qualificações

Experiência consolidada em Governança de Dados, preferencialmente em: Ambientes de alta complexidade técnica; Contextos com múltiplos stakeholders; Plataformas analíticas, Data Lake, Data Warehouse ou arquiteturas Lakehouse. Conhecimento sólido e aplicado em: Catalogação, classificação e gestão de metadados; Qualidade, linhagem e ciclo de vida de dados; Gestão de acessos e proteção de dados sensíveis; LGPD e frameworks de governança e privacidade, como DAMA-DMBOK, ISO 27001 e SOC 2. Experiência atuando em conjunto com: Engenharia de Dados; Analytics; Segurança da Informação; Privacidade. Capacidade de implementar governança de forma prática; automatizada; integrada aos processos. Forte habilidade para: traduzir requisitos regulatórios em controles técnicos aplicáveis; definir métricas e acompanhar evolução de maturidade; navegar com fluidez entre contextos técnicos, jurídicos e de negócio. Excelente comunicação e capacidade de simplificar temas complexos para diferentes públicos (Técnicos; Executivos; Áreas de negócio). Perfil com: Alta autonomia; Visão sistêmica; Capacidade de influência; Forte orientação a impacto e resultados. Capacidade de engajar áreas multifuncionais sem relação hierárquica direta. Perfil colaborativo, pragmático e orientado à construção de soluções escaláveis.

Seria muito legal se você tivesse (diferencial):

Experiência com: Databricks Unity Catalog, Arquiteturas Lakehouse; Ferramentas de catalogação, qualidade, observabilidade e linhagem de dados. Conhecimento prático em: SQL; Automação de controles; Políticas como código; Data contracts. Experiência com: Integração de logs de auditoria; Soluções de SIEM; Monitoramento de segurança. Certificações em: Governança de Dados; Privacidade; Segurança da Informação. Experiência em: Varejo; E-commerce; Ambientes de alta escala e volumetria de dados. Conhecimento sobre: ANPD; Cenário regulatório brasileiro de proteção de dados. Formação em: Tecnologia; Engenharia; Estatística; Direito Digital; Áreas correlatas.

PLR/Bônus: Um reconhecimento extra para valorizar o seu esforço e dedicação! Assistência Médica e Odontológica: Para que você tenha toda a segurança e cuidado com a sua saúde e a da sua família. title: Marketing designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Marketing designer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

AI Marketing Designer

Full-time, Remote | US Central Time Business Hours

A letter from our client

Our client wanted us to share this role directly in their own words because they're looking for someone exceptional to help them continue growing the right way.

Over the past decade, their agency has grown to support 100+ clients across multiple industries, and they are continuing to scale carefully and intentionally. Maintaining a healthy team culture, avoiding burnout, and delivering high-quality work are major priorities for them.

Their clients range from mission-driven organizations changing lives, to restaurant and hospitality brands, to innovative tech companies building exciting products.

In recent years, the agency has become a trusted partner for businesses that previously had poor experiences with marketing agencies and lost confidence in the process. Their mission is not only to deliver great work, but also to help educate businesses on how modern digital marketing should actually be done.

Why this role exists

Currently, the owner personally handles much of the AI-assisted production work within the agency. This includes designing social media content, building websites, generating content with AI tools, and migrating websites onto a modern development stack.

The systems are working extremely well, allowing the agency to move faster than teams much larger in size. However, he has become the bottleneck.

They are now looking for someone who can take ownership of execution so leadership can focus more heavily on strategy, growth, and client relationships.

The role

This position is equal parts:

AI fluency Design and web development Both skill sets must be strong.

On the AI side:

Their ideal candidate actively uses tools like Claude, Chat GPT, and Gemini as part of a daily workflow. They understand prompting for content, imagery, coding, research, and strategy. They see AI as a multiplier for creativity and execution rather than a replacement for skill.

On the design and development side:

The candidate should be able to design professionally in Canva and Photoshop while maintaining brand consistency across multiple industries and aesthetics. They should also feel comfortable building and migrating websites using tools such as Next.js, Vercel, Git Hub, and AI-assisted coding workflows.

The team values people who understand the balance between beautiful design and conversion-focused performance.

Agency experience is strongly preferred, especially for someone familiar with fast turnarounds, proactive communication, and problem-solving before issues escalate.

What the role includes

Designing social media content for multiple brands and industries Building and migrating websites onto modern frameworks Using AI tools to accelerate production workflows Assisting with content creation, research, image generation, and code scaffolding Creating designs that are both visually strong and performance-driven Staying current on new AI tools, workflows, and technologies Collaborating with leadership to improve internal systems and efficiency

What our client is looking for

Strong AI workflow experience using tools like Claude, Chat GPT, or Gemini Experience with AI-assisted coding tools Professional Canva and Photoshop skills Comfort using Git Hub, Vercel, and modern web development workflows Basic SEO understanding Strong understanding of social media design across platforms Strong written and spoken English Availability during US Central Time business hours Previous agency experience preferred A highly proactive and self-directed mindset

What they DO NOT want

Someone who requires constant follow-up Someone who treats AI as a gimmick or shortcut Someone who forces one design style onto every brand Someone who confuses being busy with being effective Someone unwilling to continuously learn and adapt

Portfolio required

Applicants must submit a live portfolio URL with their application.

Their team would like to see:

At least 5 projects A mix of social media and website work At least one live website built end-to-end Optional examples showing how AI supported the workflow

What it's like working with them

They work hard, move quickly, and genuinely enjoy what they do. Their culture values humility, creativity, initiative, and excellence.

There is strong room for growth within the company. The person who succeeds in this role will likely have opportunities to expand into leadership and strategy over time.

If this role feels like a fit for you, please apply! They are excited to meet the right person! :)

title: Marketing designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Marketing designer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

AI Marketing Designer

Full-time, Remote | US Central Time Business Hours

A letter from our client

Our client wanted us to share this role directly in their own words because they're looking for someone exceptional to help them continue growing the right way.

Over the past decade, their agency has grown to support 100+ clients across multiple industries, and they are continuing to scale carefully and intentionally. Maintaining a healthy team culture, avoiding burnout, and delivering high-quality work are major priorities for them.

Their clients range from mission-driven organizations changing lives, to restaurant and hospitality brands, to innovative tech companies building exciting products.

In recent years, the agency has become a trusted partner for businesses that previously had poor experiences with marketing agencies and lost confidence in the process. Their mission is not only to deliver great work, but also to help educate businesses on how modern digital marketing should actually be done.

Why this role exists

Currently, the owner personally handles much of the AI-assisted production work within the agency. This includes designing social media content, building websites, generating content with AI tools, and migrating websites onto a modern development stack.

The systems are working extremely well, allowing the agency to move faster than teams much larger in size. However, he has become the bottleneck.

They are now looking for someone who can take ownership of execution so leadership can focus more heavily on strategy, growth, and client relationships.

The role

This position is equal parts:

AI fluency Design and web development Both skill sets must be strong.

On the AI side:

Their ideal candidate actively uses tools like Claude, Chat GPT, and Gemini as part of a daily workflow. They understand prompting for content, imagery, coding, research, and strategy. They see AI as a multiplier for creativity and execution rather than a replacement for skill.

On the design and development side:

The candidate should be able to design professionally in Canva and Photoshop while maintaining brand consistency across multiple industries and aesthetics. They should also feel comfortable building and migrating websites using tools such as Next.js, Vercel, Git Hub, and AI-assisted coding workflows.

The team values people who understand the balance between beautiful design and conversion-focused performance.

Agency experience is strongly preferred, especially for someone familiar with fast turnarounds, proactive communication, and problem-solving before issues escalate.

What the role includes

Designing social media content for multiple brands and industries Building and migrating websites onto modern frameworks Using AI tools to accelerate production workflows Assisting with content creation, research, image generation, and code scaffolding Creating designs that are both visually strong and performance-driven Staying current on new AI tools, workflows, and technologies Collaborating with leadership to improve internal systems and efficiency

What our client is looking for

Strong AI workflow experience using tools like Claude, Chat GPT, or Gemini Experience with AI-assisted coding tools Professional Canva and Photoshop skills Comfort using Git Hub, Vercel, and modern web development workflows Basic SEO understanding Strong understanding of social media design across platforms Strong written and spoken English Availability during US Central Time business hours Previous agency experience preferred A highly proactive and self-directed mindset

What they DO NOT want

Someone who requires constant follow-up Someone who treats AI as a gimmick or shortcut Someone who forces one design style onto every brand Someone who confuses being busy with being effective Someone unwilling to continuously learn and adapt

Portfolio required

Applicants must submit a live portfolio URL with their application.

Their team would like to see:

At least 5 projects A mix of social media and website work At least one live website built end-to-end Optional examples showing how AI supported the workflow

What it's like working with them

They work hard, move quickly, and genuinely enjoy what they do. Their culture values humility, creativity, initiative, and excellence.

There is strong room for growth within the company. The person who succeeds in this role will likely have opportunities to expand into leadership and strategy over time.

If this role feels like a fit for you, please apply! They are excited to meet the right person! :)

description:

Ensino médio Completo. Habilitação em Empilhadeira (NR 11). Carteira de Habilitação B. Disponibilidade para atuar em regime de turno e escala. Vivência no pacote office, principalmente Excel; Conhecimento em procedimentos de recebimento, conferência e controle de estoque, em sistema ERP (movimentações, baixas, requisições) e em inventário físico e contagem cíclica.

title: Marketing designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Marketing designer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

AI Marketing Designer

Full-time, Remote | US Central Time Business Hours

A letter from our client

Our client wanted us to share this role directly in their own words because they're looking for someone exceptional to help them continue growing the right way.

Over the past decade, their agency has grown to support 100+ clients across multiple industries, and they are continuing to scale carefully and intentionally. Maintaining a healthy team culture, avoiding burnout, and delivering high-quality work are major priorities for them.

Their clients range from mission-driven organizations changing lives, to restaurant and hospitality brands, to innovative tech companies building exciting products.

In recent years, the agency has become a trusted partner for businesses that previously had poor experiences with marketing agencies and lost confidence in the process. Their mission is not only to deliver great work, but also to help educate businesses on how modern digital marketing should actually be done.

Why this role exists

Currently, the owner personally handles much of the AI-assisted production work within the agency. This includes designing social media content, building websites, generating content with AI tools, and migrating websites onto a modern development stack.

The systems are working extremely well, allowing the agency to move faster than teams much larger in size. However, he has become the bottleneck.

They are now looking for someone who can take ownership of execution so leadership can focus more heavily on strategy, growth, and client relationships.

The role

This position is equal parts:

AI fluency Design and web development Both skill sets must be strong.

On the AI side:

Their ideal candidate actively uses tools like Claude, Chat GPT, and Gemini as part of a daily workflow. They understand prompting for content, imagery, coding, research, and strategy. They see AI as a multiplier for creativity and execution rather than a replacement for skill.

On the design and development side:

The candidate should be able to design professionally in Canva and Photoshop while maintaining brand consistency across multiple industries and aesthetics. They should also feel comfortable building and migrating websites using tools such as Next.js, Vercel, Git Hub, and AI-assisted coding workflows.

The team values people who understand the balance between beautiful design and conversion-focused performance.

Agency experience is strongly preferred, especially for someone familiar with fast turnarounds, proactive communication, and problem-solving before issues escalate.

What the role includes

Designing social media content for multiple brands and industries Building and migrating websites onto modern frameworks Using AI tools to accelerate production workflows Assisting with content creation, research, image generation, and code scaffolding Creating designs that are both visually strong and performance-driven Staying current on new AI tools, workflows, and technologies Collaborating with leadership to improve internal systems and efficiency

What our client is looking for

Strong AI workflow experience using tools like Claude, Chat GPT, or Gemini Experience with AI-assisted coding tools Professional Canva and Photoshop skills Comfort using Git Hub, Vercel, and modern web development workflows Basic SEO understanding Strong understanding of social media design across platforms Strong written and spoken English Availability during US Central Time business hours Previous agency experience preferred A highly proactive and self-directed mindset

What they DO NOT want

Someone who requires constant follow-up Someone who treats AI as a gimmick or shortcut Someone who forces one design style onto every brand Someone who confuses being busy with being effective Someone unwilling to continuously learn and adapt

Portfolio required

Applicants must submit a live portfolio URL with their application.

Their team would like to see:

At least 5 projects A mix of social media and website work At least one live website built end-to-end Optional examples showing how AI supported the workflow

What it's like working with them

They work hard, move quickly, and genuinely enjoy what they do. Their culture values humility, creativity, initiative, and excellence.

There is strong room for growth within the company. The person who succeeds in this role will likely have opportunities to expand into leadership and strategy over time.

If this role feels like a fit for you, please apply! They are excited to meet the right person! :)

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Vacation rental revenue manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're hiring a detail-oriented, numbers-driven Vacation Rental Revenue Manager to help Emperor Rentals improve pricing, occupancy, and revenue across our short-term rental portfolio.

title: Business specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

1, Document Preparation and Analysis (Pre-Shipment): This phase focuses on ensuring all documentation is correct before shipment. It includes receiving and checking the Purchase Order (PO), the fiscal classification (NCM) of the goods, analyzing draft documents (CI, PL, BL drafts), and initial registration in the system.


2, Shipment Management and Customs Procedures: This stage covers the active management of the process while the cargo is in transit. It involves obtaining the Import License (LI), collecting original documents, validating the Bill of Lading (BL), and continuous coordination with the customs broker and the bonded terminal

.
3, Clearance Monitoring and Closing (Post-Arrival): This phase begins upon cargo arrival. It includes full door-to-door logistics follow-up, cargo presence confirmation, monitoring customs clearance (DI/DUIMP), coordinating domestic transport, and finally, archiving all documents to close the proces

s.
4, Invoice Auditing and Cost Validation: This phase focuses on verifying the accuracy of all operational costs before payment. It includes receiving and cross-referencing invoices (from freight forwarders, carriers, terminals, customs brokers) against negotiated tariffs, operational records, and system data (e.g., demurrage/detention days, storage fees) to identify and dispute discrepanci

es.
5, Payment Processing and Budget Allocation: This stage covers the financial execution and control. It involves launching approved invoices into the financial system (ERP), correctly allocating all costs to the specific import process or cost center, scheduling payments according to financial policy, and serving as the main point of contact for supplier payment inquir

ies.
6, Cost Analysis and Performance Reporting: This final phase focuses on data analysis and strategic support. It includes compiling financial data, generating periodic reports (e.g., total logistics cost, cost-per-container, variance analysis against budget), and providing data-driven insights to support new supplier negotiations and identify cost-saving opportuni ties.

Atender às reservas e requisições de materiais, separando e entregando conforme necessidade das áreas internas. Receber materiais conferindo AR (Autorização de Recebimento) e condições físicas dos produtos. Armazenar os materiais em locais apropriados, respeitando critérios de segurança, validade e acessibilidade. Realizar contagens cíclicas e apoiar na execução de inventários físicos. Lançar movimentações básicas no sistema ERP, com apoio ou sob orientação do Almoxarife II ou do líder. Comunicar divergências ou anomalias nos materiais ou processos ao superior imediato. Apoiar em outras atividades do setor sempre que necessário. Realizar descargas, e movimentações dentro do almoxarifado com o uso de empilhadeira. Realizar outras atividades correlatas às descritas acima, compatível com a sua condição pessoal e conforme solicitado pelo seu superior imediato.

Requisitos: Ensino médio Completo. Habilitação em Empilhadeira (NR 11). Carteira de Habilitação B. Disponibilidade para atuar em regime de turno e escala. Vivência no pacote office, principalmente Excel; Conhecimento em procedimentos de recebimento, conferência e controle de estoque, em sistema ERP (movimentações, baixas, requisições) e em inventário físico e contagem cíclica.

Ao nos enviar seu currículo e dados pessoais, considera-se que você deu seu consentimento para que mantenhamos suas informações em nosso banco de dados de recrutamento de talentos. Todas as informações fornecidas serão usadas exclusivamente para o processo seletivo. A RGE somente coletará, utilizará, processará ou divulgará informações pessoais quando e onde for permitido pelas leis aplicáveis.

Atuação remota, integrada a uma equipe multidisciplinar (psicólogos, terapeutas ocupacionais), com contato direto com ferramentas tecnológicas de suporte terapêutico. Responsabilidades

Realizar avaliações e intervenções fonoaudiológicas remotas com ênfase em linguagem receptiva e expressiva, comunicação funcional, processamento auditivo e habilidades pragmáticas. Elaborar planos terapêuticos individualizados e relatórios de evolução. Participar de reuniões de equipe e devolutivas via videoconferência. Colaborar com a equipe de produto no refinamento de jogos terapêuticos e ferramentas digitais. Requisitos obrigatórios

CNPJ ativo já aberto (pré-requisito eliminatório) Graduação em Fonoaudiologia com CRFa ativo Experiência mínima de 2 anos em atendimento clínico infantil Experiência comprovada com TEA, TDAH, atrasos globais do desenvolvimento ou distúrbios de linguagem Conhecimento em abordagens como PECS, ABA aplicada à comunicação, PROMPT, Hanen ou similares Estrutura adequada para teleatendimento (internet estável, ambiente reservado, equipamento com câmera e áudio de qualidade) Diferenciais

Pós-graduação ou especialização em Linguagem Infantil ou Neurociência aplicada. Experiência com comunicação alternativa e aumentativa (CAA). Familiaridade com ferramentas digitais e interesse por inovação na prática clínica. Experiência prévia com teleatendimento fonoaudiológico. Modelo de contratação

Contratação PJ por plantão de 12 horas (8h às 20h). Valor do plantão: R$ 480,00. O que oferecemos

Trabalho 100% remoto, com escolha dos dias de plantão conforme disponibilidade. Acesso a ferramentas tecnológicas proprietárias de suporte terapêutico. Equipe multidisciplinar colaborativa e focada em inovação. Atuação em contextos institucionais de impacto. Como se candidatar

Envie seu currículo e uma breve carta de apresentação descrevendo sua experiência com o público infantil neurodivergente. Inclua seu número de CRFa, confirmação de CNPJ ativo e disponibilidade para início.

title: Designer/diretor de arte hands-on
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Designer/diretor de arte hands-on em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Vaga Temporária – Criação (Designer/Diretor de Arte Hands-on) – 100% remota

Período: 1 a 31 de julho

Dedicação: Integral, 100% remoto

Localização da agência: São Paulo (atendimento nacional)

Sobre a UAI Brasil

Somos uma boutique de comunicação especializada em saúde. Atuamos como parceiros estratégicos, criando soluções taylor made que traduzem ciência em cuidado. Entregamos visão, estratégia e execução com sensibilidade, compliance e foco em resultados. Nossa experiência vai de campanhas institucionais e promocionais na área da saúde a comunicação interna e eventos, sempre com responsabilidade e criatividade.

O que buscamos

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional híbrido(a), entre os níveis júnior e pleno, para cobrir férias de um membro da equipe de criação. Temos uma grande demanda diária de peças de comunicação e precisamos de uma pessoa com disponibilidade e dedicação integrais.

Responsabilidades

Atuar diretamente sob coordenação da direção de arte e Heads de Atendimento. Desenvolver peças digitais e físicas para: Comunicação interna (cards, e-mails, vídeos para TV corporativa, cartazes, banners, paineis); Campanhas institucionais e de produtos para saúde; Materiais para eventos em geral. Criar materiais visuais alinhados aos briefings, com proatividade e soluções criativas. Apoiar demandas de campanhas e projetos pontuais em saúde. Editar vídeos em motion design em nível intermediário para pequenas demandas do dia a dia. Preparar apresentações para campanhas e outras necessidades dos clientes.

Requisitos

Experiência comprovada em design gráfico e digital. Domínio de ferramentas: Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, In Design, After Effects e ferramentas de IA aplicadas a design e vídeo. Utilizamos também como apoio no dia a dia, especialmente para apresentações internas, Canva, Cap Cut, Clip Champ e outros. Com IA, incorporamos ao nosso trabalho o uso de ferramentas diversas do pacote Magnific (ex-Free Pik). Perfil proativo, organizado e colaborativo. Capacidade de equilibrar execução técnica com visão criativa. Disponibilidade integral durante o período da vaga.

Diferenciais

Habilidade em motion design (nível intermediário). Experiência, mesmo que inicial, com ferramentas de IA para criação de imagens e animações simples. Habilidade com apresentações em PPT e/ou Canva. Experiência prévia em comunicação corporativa ou saúde.

Informações importantes

Contrato temporário: 1 mês (1 a 31 de julho). Importante: temos possibilidade de tornar esta vaga permanente. Neste momento, garantimos somente a contratação temporária, mas estamos com alguns projetos em andamento que podem possibilitar uma nova negociação, se houver interesse, com extensão de contrato. Modelo de trabalho: 100% remoto. PJ. Pretensão salarial: informar no envio da candidatura (fundamental para agilizar a seleção).

Envie seu portfólio e pretensão salarial para:

Assunto: Vaga Temporária Criação – Julho 2026

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Financial advisor em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A IBBRA Full Family Office é uma consultoria patrimonial 360o. Nosso propósito é ser para as famílias Brasileiras, um agente de mudança cultural em torno do patrimônio, fomentando emancipação e a realização de objetivos

Buscamos para nossa equipe pessoas dispostas a mudar a cultura patrimonial das famílias brasileiras enquanto se desenvolvem, estruram-se e alcançam novos horizontes.

O executivo de vendas irá atuar no desenvolvimento e gestão da carteira de clientes de alto patrimônio, conduzindo o relacionamento comercial, identificando oportunidades de negócio e assegurando uma experiência consultiva e integrada ao longo de toda a jornada comercial do cliente.

Gerenciar o relacionamento com o cliente, sendo o principal contato e conselheiro de confiança, prestando consultoria em disponibilidade total e permanente à família atendida. Atuar de forma consultiva, estratégica e contínua na jornada patrimonial Atrair, desenvolver e gerir carteira de clientes de alta renda, com foco em crescimento e retenção Implementar e monitorar estratégias de planejamento patrimonial abrangentes (investimentos, sucessão, proteção e gestão orçamentária), assegurando aderência aos objetivos familiares Supervisionar carteiras de investimentos e a evolução patrimonial, propondo ajustes conforme perfil de risco e cenário econômico Conduzir análises financeiras aprofundadas para otimização e alavancagem patrimonial Coordenar ações multidisciplinares com advogados, contadores e outros especialistas Coletar e analisar dados financeiros e contextuais, gerando inteligência para tomada de decisão Promover educação financeira e apoiar a autonomia dos clientes e suas famílias Atuar com postura ética, fiduciária e independente, em conformidade com as regulamentações

Requisitos e Qualificações:

Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Economia, Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas Experiência com atendimento ao cliente e/ou mercado financeiro Habilidade de comunicação e relacionamento Certificação CPA (mínimo) ou em andamento Diferencial: Certificações CFP, CEA, Ancord, PQO Diferencial: Inglês intermediário ou avançado

O que oferecemos?

Ambiente colaborativo, com oportunidade real de crescimento profissional; Treinamentos e acompanhamento para desenvolvimento das suas habilidades; Incentivo intelectual.

title: Designer/diretor de arte hands-on
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Designer/diretor de arte hands-on em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Vaga Temporária – Criação (Designer/Diretor de Arte Hands-on) – 100% remota

Período: 1 a 31 de julho

Dedicação: Integral, 100% remoto

Localização da agência: São Paulo (atendimento nacional)

Sobre a UAI Brasil

Somos uma boutique de comunicação especializada em saúde. Atuamos como parceiros estratégicos, criando soluções taylor made que traduzem ciência em cuidado. Entregamos visão, estratégia e execução com sensibilidade, compliance e foco em resultados. Nossa experiência vai de campanhas institucionais e promocionais na área da saúde a comunicação interna e eventos, sempre com responsabilidade e criatividade.

O que buscamos

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional híbrido(a), entre os níveis júnior e pleno, para cobrir férias de um membro da equipe de criação. Temos uma grande demanda diária de peças de comunicação e precisamos de uma pessoa com disponibilidade e dedicação integrais.

Responsabilidades

Atuar diretamente sob coordenação da direção de arte e Heads de Atendimento. Desenvolver peças digitais e físicas para: Comunicação interna (cards, e-mails, vídeos para TV corporativa, cartazes, banners, paineis); Campanhas institucionais e de produtos para saúde; Materiais para eventos em geral. Criar materiais visuais alinhados aos briefings, com proatividade e soluções criativas. Apoiar demandas de campanhas e projetos pontuais em saúde. Editar vídeos em motion design em nível intermediário para pequenas demandas do dia a dia. Preparar apresentações para campanhas e outras necessidades dos clientes.

Requisitos

Experiência comprovada em design gráfico e digital. Domínio de ferramentas: Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, In Design, After Effects e ferramentas de IA aplicadas a design e vídeo. Utilizamos também como apoio no dia a dia, especialmente para apresentações internas, Canva, Cap Cut, Clip Champ e outros. Com IA, incorporamos ao nosso trabalho o uso de ferramentas diversas do pacote Magnific (ex-Free Pik). Perfil proativo, organizado e colaborativo. Capacidade de equilibrar execução técnica com visão criativa. Disponibilidade integral durante o período da vaga.

Diferenciais

Habilidade em motion design (nível intermediário). Experiência, mesmo que inicial, com ferramentas de IA para criação de imagens e animações simples. Habilidade com apresentações em PPT e/ou Canva. Experiência prévia em comunicação corporativa ou saúde.

Informações importantes

Contrato temporário: 1 mês (1 a 31 de julho). Importante: temos possibilidade de tornar esta vaga permanente. Neste momento, garantimos somente a contratação temporária, mas estamos com alguns projetos em andamento que podem possibilitar uma nova negociação, se houver interesse, com extensão de contrato. Modelo de trabalho: 100% remoto. PJ. Pretensão salarial: informar no envio da candidatura (fundamental para agilizar a seleção).

Envie seu portfólio e pretensão salarial para:

Assunto: Vaga Temporária Criação – Julho 2026

title: Customer success manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer success manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Employment Type: Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2 B)

About Sisense

Sisense is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (An Paa S) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology.

With the recent launch of Sisense Intelligence and the Intelligence Assistant, we are accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences that bridge insights to real-time action.

The Role

As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts. You will build deep relationships, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, maximize value, and fuel retention and expansion. You will collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication and proactive guidance.

Why Join Our Customer Success Team

This is a strategic, high-impact role where you will own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption). You will work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to Sisense's growth in embedded AI analytics.

About You

You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused. You are a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor. You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs. You are proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities. You are collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning.

Requirements

3–5 years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (Saa S/BI/analytics preferred). Strong track record driving product adoption, value realization, NRR, and revenue expansion. Excellent presentation and executive communication skills; experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships. Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio. Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI. Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions. Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps. Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required; Portuguese a plus). Results-driven with critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus. Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment managing multiple priorities. Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/Gen AI enablement, or similar technical solutions.

How You'll Ramp

By Day 30

Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (Sisense values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes). Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value.

By Day 60

Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals). Deepen product/technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work. Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side-by-side with the team.

By Day 90

Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion). Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement. Become a key contributor to the team's revenue retention and growth goals.

What We Offer

Employment through a partner agency (B2 B). Competitive base salary up to USD 3,500 per month (depending on experience). Eligibility for a quarterly performance bonus. Opportunity to work with a global leader in AI-powered embedded analytics. Flexible remote work with a collaborative international team. Professional development and growth opportunities within Customer Success.

We are currently inviting qualified ESL teachers to apply for a remote instructional role supporting international learners through our structured online teaching platform.

This is a contract-based teaching position offering self-managed scheduling within a professional global education environment. Why Join Us

· Remote teaching structure

· Self-managed scheduling

· Access to professional development opportunities

· Supportive global educator network

· Dedicated online teaching portal Core Requirements

• School-aged learners

All curriculum materials are provided and accessible in advance of teaching sessions. Next Step

Qualified candidates are invited to submit their resume for review.

title: Business specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

1, Document Preparation and Analysis (Pre-Shipment): This phase focuses on ensuring all documentation is correct before shipment. It includes receiving and checking the Purchase Order (PO), the fiscal classification (NCM) of the goods, analyzing draft documents (CI, PL, BL drafts), and initial registration in the system.

2, Shipment Management and Customs Procedures: This stage covers the active management of the process while the cargo is in transit. It involves obtaining the Import License (LI), collecting original documents, validating the Bill of Lading (BL), and continuous coordination with the customs broker and the bonded terminal

.
3, Clearance Monitoring and Closing (Post-Arrival): This phase begins upon cargo arrival. It includes full door-to-door logistics follow-up, cargo presence confirmation, monitoring customs clearance (DI/DUIMP), coordinating domestic transport, and finally, archiving all documents to close the proces

s.
4, Invoice Auditing and Cost Validation: This phase focuses on verifying the accuracy of all operational costs before payment. It includes receiving and cross-referencing invoices (from freight forwarders, carriers, terminals, customs brokers) against negotiated tariffs, operational records, and system data (e. G., demurrage/detention days, storage fees) to identify and dispute discrepanci

es.
5, Payment Processing and Budget Allocation: This stage covers the financial execution and control. It involves launching approved invoices into the financial system (ERP), correctly allocating all costs to the specific import process or cost center, scheduling payments according to financial policy, and serving as the main point of contact for supplier payment inquir

ies.
6, Cost Analysis and Performance Reporting: This final phase focuses on data analysis and strategic support. It includes compiling financial data, generating periodic reports (e. G., total logistics cost, cost-per-container, variance analysis against budget), and providing data-driven insights to support new supplier negotiations and identify cost-saving opportuni ties.

description:

JOB DESCRIPTION

A Movida é uma empresa de soluções inovadoras em mobilidade urbana e modelo de negócios com forte direcionamento para desenvolvimento socioambiental. Desde 2006 no mercado, conta hoje com a frota mais nova do Brasil e dispõe de lojas nas principais cidades e aeroportos do país. A companhia é reconhecida como uma locadora moderna, alinhada às últimas tendências tecnológicas e que investe em diversificação e renovação de frota, treinamento de funcionários e serviços exclusivos.

Norteada pela devoção em servir, foi pioneira em oferecer serviços como aluguel mensal e de longo prazo para pessoa física, opções para pré-pagamento e diárias de 27 horas. Focada em tecnologia, também saiu na frente do setor ao oferecer soluções como web check-in, wi-fi no carro, chatbot nas redes sociais e tecnologia de pagamento contactless em todos os veículos.

Empresa da SIMPAR, hoje faz parte da Movida Participações, criada em 2015 para administrar as operações de Aluguel de Carros, Venda de Seminovos e de Gestão de Terceirização de Frotas de veículos leves.

Com mais de 6000 colaboradores apaixonados, a Movida se diferencia pelo seu "jeitão" inovador e descomplicado. Carrega em seu DNA o foco no cliente e a sua GENTE como prioridade!

Todos os processos seletivos conduzidos pela MOVIDA  são afirmativos, inclusivos e não discriminatórios.

RESPONSIBILITIES AND ASSIGNMENTS

Missão do cargo:

Atuará de forma próxima às lojas, identificando oportunidades de desenvolvimento e propondo ações práticas que acelerem a curva de aprendizado, fortaleçam a cultura Movida e impactem diretamente os resultados do negócio.

Principais Responsabilidades:  Execução e Facilitação: Ministrar treinamentos para colaboradores e workshops técnicos/comportamentais no ambiente de Loja Escola.  Formação de Multiplicadores: Identificar talentos internos e capacitá-los na disseminação do conhecimento.  Gestão de LMS e Indicadores: Administrar a plataforma de aprendizagem (LMS), gerir inscrições e converter dados brutos em relatórios estratégicos de desempenho e qualidade.  Logística e Organização: Planejar cronogramas anuais, organizar a logística de viagens para instrutores/alunos e coordenar eventos de Educação Corporativa.  Gestão Administrativa: Gestão de fornecedores de T&D e garantir a organização da agenda da Loja Escola.  Apoio em Projetos: Colaborar no desenho de trilhas de aprendizagem e novos projetos de T&D alinhados à estratégia do negócio.  Suporte em projetos especiais de T&D, trilhas de carreira e ações corporativas de desenvolvimento.  Acompanhar turmas de Educação Corporativa, garantindo presença, engajamento e conclusão.

REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS Ensino Médio Completo; Possuir CNH válida; Vivência ou experiência na área de vendas; Conhecimento no pacote office.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

Os benefícios tradicionais que você já conhece, nós também temos. Queremos te mostrar que vamos além. Saiba mais!

LIGADO EM VOCÊ:  Atendimento especializado para a nossa gente e familiares por meio de uma central 24 horas para apoio psicológico, sobre saúde, social, familiar, financeiro e/ou jurídico e tudo isso com sigilo absoluto. Licença Maternidade  e Paternidade estendidas  + Kit nascimento  para recém-mamães e recém-papais. Sabemos o quanto a educação das crianças e adolescentes é importante. Aqui na MOVIDA , damos aquela ajuda na compra do kit escolar  para os filhos da nossa gente. Nossa gente tem acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma de descontos  em viagens, cultura e entretenimento, serviços, gastronomia, educação e bem-estar. Pela Universidade MOVIDA , a nossa gente aprende e potencializa seu desenvolvimento profissional, tornando cada um(a) protagonista de sua carreira. Reconhecemos e valorizamos a nossa gente veterana  que completa anos de casa. Quem possui mais de 15 anos , ainda tem um evento mega especial. Cantinho da Mamãe:  O espaço, na Matriz no Itaim Bibi e Sede Administrativa em Mogi das Cruzes, é dedicado as mamães que retornam de licença maternidade e querem seguir com o aleitamento materno.  No local, há todos os itens para retirar e armazenar o leite, com privacidade e conforto. Totalpass: Acesso a uma ampla rede de academias e serviços de saúde mental e nutrição, promovendo hábitos saudáveis e bem-estar.

Se identificou com essa vaga? Conheça as nossas vagas, inscreva-se e vamos juntos participar dessa Empresa que cresce todos os dias.

SOBRE A MOVIDA

Sobre Movida

A Movida (MOVI3) é uma empresa de aluguel de carros que oferece soluções inovadoras em mobilidade urbana para todo tipo de necessidade. Pioneira em oferecer serviços como aluguel mensal para pessoa física, Wi-Fi no carro, pré-pagamento e Chat Bot nas redes sociais, foi a primeira locadora do país a ir além do carro, ajudando a revolucionar o setor de locação no Brasil. Antenada aos novos tempos, investe em sustentabilidade, sendo a primeira locadora de veículos no mundo, listada em bolsa, a receber a Certificação de Empresa B, fazendo parte de um seleto grupo de companhias que têm como modelo de negócios o desenvolvimento socioambiental. No Brasil, foi a primeira a ter um programa como o Carbon Free, que neutraliza as emissões de CO2 das locações dos seus clientes.

Desde 2006 no mercado, a Movida foi adquirida em 2013 pela JSL, abriu capital em fevereiro de 2017 e hoje é uma das empresas da SIMPAR S. A. Com perfil inovador aliado a forte governança corporativa, atua tanto no varejo, com aluguel de carros, como no mercado corporativo, com a terceirização de frotas para empresas, além da venda de seminovos. Após diversos investimentos nos últimos quatro anos, conta com uma frota de mais de 268 mil veículos, 259 lojas de aluguel de carros e 89 pontos de venda de seminovos. title: Data product associate
description:

About Yipit Data: Yipit Data is the market-leading data and analytics firm. We analyze billions of data points every day to provide accurate, detailed insights across industries, including consumer brands, technology, software, and healthcare. Our insights team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean, and analyze the data that many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend on. We raised $475 M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation over $1 B, further accelerating our growth and market impact. We have been recognized multiple times as one of Inc’s Best Workplaces. As a fast-growing company backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners, Yipit Data is driven by a people-first culture rooted in mastery, ownership, and transparency. With offices in New York, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore, we continue to expand our reach and impact across global markets.
About the Role: We currently have 60+ Data team members in our Investor business who build, create and maintain our data products, and we are looking to further expand the team to continue to increase our product portfolio. Those with strong analytical skills who are passionate about data and excited to scale quickly to deliver top-tier products to our clients are encouraged to apply. At Yipit Data, we value ownership and impact. Your growth is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at Yipit Data is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Our career ladder also rewards strong performance with regular opportunities for compensation increases and promotions. See this short video
to learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current data team members love working here!
As a Data Associate, you will: Own high-impact data products end-to-end
— driving product success by delivering best-in-class outputs with a focus on accuracy, client value, and efficiency. You’ll ramp quickly into full ownership of your products and workflows, operating with minimal oversight. Work with massive amounts of data
to answer our clients’ key questions about the companies and datasets we analyze. You’ll develop deep expertise in our proprietary methods and techniques, building strong mental models that allow you to ensure data accuracy, identify methodology gaps, and derive key insights. Tackle complex data problems independently , using strong analytical judgment to refine methodologies, test new datasets, and solve challenges that require innovative thinking — even when information is incomplete or ambiguous. Use AI and tooling to drive meaningful leverage
— significantly increasing speed, reducing manual work, and beginning to automate portions of workflows. You’ll standardize best practices and build repeatable processes, always maintaining a high bar for correctness and quality while validating AI-generated outputs. Collaborate cross-functionally with Research, Engineering, and other teams
— coordinating across functions to unblock work, align on best practices, and develop technical solutions that streamline workflows, optimize data processes, and push the boundaries of automation. Identify and drive improvements to products and data pipelines , contributing ideas for new products, enhancements, and features. This could include developing new methodologies, exploring and scaling the use of new third-party datasets, or improving product profitability — all with a clear understanding of what drives value for clients.
You Are Likely To Succeed If: You have 4–5+ years of experience in data, business, or predictive analytics and are proficient in SQL, Python, and Py Spark You have a proven track record of quickly learning new concepts, particularly complex data methodologies, and building strong mental models of how and why data works You actively use AI tools (e.g., Chat GPT, Copilot, or similar) to accelerate your work and are excited about using AI to drive leverage — not just productivity, but fundamentally better and faster ways of working You can clearly communicate complex concepts — including methodology, risks, and tradeoffs — both orally and in writing You have a strong ownership mentality and are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company You can manage multiple projects simultaneously, independently prioritize tasks, and make sound decisions with incomplete information You have experience using sample or panel data to make precise estimates that guide decision-making You have a background in financial markets or are interested in learning more about data-driven investing You have an Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)
For You: Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) Flexible work schedule Personal laptop Health and wellness package Remote work

Proactively identify opportunities to improve the reporting cycle, increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the quality of insight month over month. Salesforce Data Quality & Governance Strengthen Salesforce as a system of record by validating data, identifying reporting exceptions, and partnering with Renewals, Rev Ops, Finance, and Revenue Technology stakeholders to ensure dashboards are accurate and items that are not true churn are not reported as churn. Monthly Business Review Preparation & Presentation Prepare materials, briefing documents, and commentary for monthly business reviews. Deep dive into reported numbers, explain key movements and drivers, present insights to senior leaders including the CFO and CCO, respond to queries, track actions, and evolve the reporting process.
Required Qualifications & Experience Technical & Operational Expertise Strong experience in an analytical, finance, revenue operations, customer operations, or similar data-driven role. Bachelor's degree minimum, ideally in Economics, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field. Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, particularly opportunity management, renewal and churn data, reporting structures, and data flows that impact customer and revenue reporting. High proficiency in Excel, with the ability to manage complex calculations, reconcile datasets, investigate variances, and build structured reporting outputs. Experience with BI or reporting tools such as Power BI is advantageous. Revenue & Churn Acumen Experience working with finance and revenue data, including the concepts of annual recurring revenue (ARR) and contracted annual recurring revenue (CARR) in a subscription or Saa S business. Ability to connect churn revenue metrics to retention activity, customer health indicators, and operational performance metrics. Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to double click into results, identify root causes, and explain whether movements are driven by data quality, process, customer behaviour, commercial actions, or broader business trends. Understanding of customer lifecycle, renewals, retention, and churn management processes is highly desirable. Leadership & Stakeholder Management Competent and confident presenting to, influencing, and constructively challenging senior stakeholders. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across multiple stakeholders in a global organisation. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to turn complex data into clear insight, concise commentary, and practical recommendations. Proactive, curious, and comfortable operating in an evolving environment where processes, systems, and definitions continue to mature.
