title: Médico nefrologista em telemedicina (com rqe)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico nefrologista em telemedicina (com rqe) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. *
OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO NEFROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"
Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!
A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em
Nefrologia!
Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.
*
SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:
* A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.
*
O QUE PROCURAMOS:
*
Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de
Nefrologia
, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.
*PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*
Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Nefrologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.
Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.
Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.
Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.
Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.
Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.
Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças nefrológicas.
Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.
Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.
Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.
Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Nefrologia.
Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.
Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.
Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.
Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.
Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.
Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.
Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.

title: Project manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Ten16 Creative is looking for a mid-level Project Manager based in Brazil to help keep our creative work clear, organized, and moving forward. Ten16 is a creative partner for technology-driven companies, helping teams turn complex products into clear, market-ready brand, campaign, design, web, video, and motion experiences. Our clients operate across areas such as AI, Saa S, gaming, entertainment, consumer electronics, connected hardware, and B2 B technology.
This is a remote contractor position for someone who is experienced enough to manage multiple moving pieces with confidence, but still hands-on, adaptable, and eager to grow with a fast-moving creative team. The right person will bring structure to creative work without slowing it down. They will help coordinate timelines, deliverables, client communication, internal reviews, production details, and day-to-day follow-through across projects that often involve strategy, design, writing, motion, video, web, and campaign development.
About Ten16 Creative Ten16 Creative is a global creative studio with roots in the United States and São Paulo. We help tech-driven companies make complex products easier to understand, trust, and bring to market. Our work spans brand identity, campaign development, design systems, web design, presentations, marketing assets, video, motion, 3 D animation, AI-powered production, and creative leadership.
We work with companies that need a creative partner who can bring clarity, consistency, and structure to sophisticated products. Our clients have included technology, AI, Saa S, gaming, entertainment, and consumer electronics brands, with representative work across companies and projects in various tech-driven spaces.
About the Role The Project Manager will be responsible for helping Ten16 plan, coordinate, and deliver creative projects from kickoff through final delivery. This person will work closely with creative directors, designers, producers, writers, motion teams, developers, and clients to make sure everyone understands what needs to happen, when it needs to happen, and what is required to deliver excellent work.
This role is ideal for someone who has already worked in an agency, creative studio, production company, marketing team, or digital product environment and understands how creative work moves from brief to execution. The role does not require senior-level account leadership, but it does require organization, fluent English and Portuguese communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
You will manage active project timelines and ensure that milestones, deliverables, meetings, and reviews are clearly documented and communicated. You will help turn creative scopes into practical schedules, making sure that internal team members understand priorities and that clients understand what is needed from them to keep projects moving.
You will coordinate daily and weekly project activity across brand, design, web, video, motion, campaign, and presentation work. This includes assigning or tracking tasks, following up on open items, preparing meeting agendas, documenting decisions, and making sure feedback is captured accurately. You will also help maintain project management tools, shared folders, project boards, calendars, and production documents so the team always has a reliable source of truth.
You will support client-facing communication in English with professionalism and clarity. This may include sending status updates, recapping meetings, organizing feedback, preparing for presentations, and helping the team stay ahead of deadlines. Because Ten16 works with technology-driven companies, you should be comfortable working on projects where the subject matter may be complex, technical, or still evolving.
You will help protect the quality of the work by making sure deliverables are complete, organized, properly labeled, and ready for review or delivery. You will not be expected to creative-direct the work, but you should have a strong eye for detail and enough creative production experience to recognize when something is missing, unclear, or not ready to send.
Qualifications The ideal candidate has approximately 3–5 years of experience in project management, creative production, account coordination, marketing operations, agency operations, or a related role. They should have experience managing creative deliverables and coordinating cross-functional teams in a remote environment.

Experience • 2–4 years in a client-facing coordination, account support, or digital project management role • Experience working with Saa S platforms, creative tech, or digital products is a plus • Background in real estate or luxury industries is a bonus, not a requirement
Skills • Exceptional written and spoken English — you will be communicating with US-based executive clients daily • Comfortable learning and navigating new software platforms quickly • Able to explain digital tools clearly to non-technical users • Highly organized with strong attention to detail • Responsive, professional, and calm under pressure • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift
Mindset • You follow through. Every time. • You communicate proactively — you don't go quiet when things get complicated • You take pride in representing a premium brand to premium clients • You're here to execute at a high level and grow with the company
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Tools You'll Work With
VEXOS platform (proprietary) · Notion or Asana · Zoom · Google Workspace · Loom

What We Offer
• Competitive salary in USD • 100% remote — work from Brazil or Mexico • Direct day-to-day collaboration with the founder • A stable, long-term role in a growing company • Opportunity to grow into greater responsibility as VEXOS scales
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Send your CV and a short Loom video (2–3 minutes) covering: 1. Who you are and what you've managed 2. Why this role interests you 3. One example of how you handled a difficult client situation
Applications without the Loom video will not be reviewed.

title: Full stack engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full stack engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About Freight Hero Freight Hero is an AI-native services company built to support the freight brokerage industry, which is in dire need of it. Robin, our autonomous AI agent, handles back-office work end to end. Our Heroes, a sharp human-in-the-loop team, catch the edge cases. Brokers pay us per load, see ROI in weeks, and reassign or eliminate the teams they used to rent.
We are backed by incredible investors, including Andrew Ng's AI Fund and supply chain specialists Dynamo Ventures.
The thesis is proven. What is next is growth, and that means building a team of incredible people around us to push the company to the next level. The product is real, the customers are real, the revenue is real, and joining now means shaping how this company runs.
About the Role This is a senior full‑stack engineering role focused on building and scaling the core Freight Hero platform. You will work across backend services, integrations, internal tools, and customer-facing features, primarily using Node.js, Type Script, React, and AWS. You won’t be inheriting a legacy monolith. You’ll be contributing to a modern, event‑driven, AI‑powered system and helping us scale it as customer adoption accelerates. You’ll collaborate closely with product, AI, and customer teams to translate real operational workflows into robust, reliable software. As the team grows, you’ll have opportunities to mentor others, influence architecture, and shape engineering best practices.
What Success Looks Like A successful engineer in this role: Builds scalable, reliable services in Node.js/Type Script that integrate deeply with customer systems. Designs and maintains AWS‑native
infrastructure that is observable, secure, and cost‑efficient. Works cross‑functionally to understand customer workflows and translate them into technical solutions. Ships high‑quality features quickly while maintaining engineering excellence. Identifies opportunities to automate, optimize, and expand the platform. Contributes to a culture of ownership, clarity, and continuous improvement.
Key Responsibilities:
Full Stack Engineering Build backend services, APIs, and workflow engines using Node.js + Type Script. Contribute to frontend components when needed using React + Vue JS. Implement robust testing, observability, and CI/CD practices.
AWS native Architecture Design and maintain cloud infrastructure using AWS services such as Lambda, RDS, Dynamo DB, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, and more. Ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost‑optimized.
Systems Integration Build integrations with TMS platforms, carrier systems, and customer‑specific tools. Work with internal teams to understand operational processes and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
AI Forward Development Collaborate with AI engineers to embed LLM‑powered workflows into the product. Use AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and automate repetitive tasks. Identify opportunities to expand AI‑driven automation across the platform.
Collaboration & Impact Work closely with product, operations, and customer success to deeply understand customer needs. Participate in technical discussions, architectural decisions, and roadmap planning. Help establish engineering best practices as the team grows.
What We Are Looking For 8+ years of professional software engineering experience. Strong expertise in Node.js, Type Script, React, and AWS cloud architecture. Experience building distributed systems, event‑driven architectures, or workflow automation. Comfortable working across the stack (backend‑heavy, but able to contribute to frontend). Strong communicator who collaborates well with non‑technical teams. High ownership mindset - you thrive in fast‑moving, ambiguous environments. Curiosity about AI and eagerness to leverage it in your day‑to‑day work. Bonus: experience in freight tech, logistics, or integrations with TMS/ERP systems.
Why Freight Hero Built at the intersection of AI and logistics, one of the most impactful spaces in B2 B tech. Work with a team that moves fast, thinks big, and cares deeply about customer outcomes. Opportunities to mentor, influence architecture, and grow as the engineering team scales. Competitive compensation with performance incentives. Fully remote with a collaborative, high‑performance culture.

title: Data product associate
description:

About Yipit Data: Yipit Data is the market-leading data and analytics firm. We analyze billions of data points every day to provide accurate, detailed insights across industries, including consumer brands, technology, software, and healthcare. Our insights team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean, and analyze the data that many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend on. We raised $475 M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation over $1 B, further accelerating our growth and market impact. We have been recognized multiple times as one of Inc’s Best Workplaces. As a fast-growing company backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners, Yipit Data is driven by a people-first culture rooted in mastery, ownership, and transparency. With offices in New York, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore, we continue to expand our reach and impact across global markets.
About the Role: We currently have 60+ Data team members in our Investor business who build, create and maintain our data products, and we are looking to further expand the team to continue to increase our product portfolio. Those with strong analytical skills who are passionate about data and excited to scale quickly to deliver top-tier products to our clients are encouraged to apply. At Yipit Data, we value ownership and impact. Your growth is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at Yipit Data is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Our career ladder also rewards strong performance with regular opportunities for compensation increases and promotions. See this short video
to learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current data team members love working here!
As a Data Associate, you will: Own high-impact data products end-to-end
— driving product success by delivering best-in-class outputs with a focus on accuracy, client value, and efficiency. You’ll ramp quickly into full ownership of your products and workflows, operating with minimal oversight. Work with massive amounts of data
to answer our clients’ key questions about the companies and datasets we analyze. You’ll develop deep expertise in our proprietary methods and techniques, building strong mental models that allow you to ensure data accuracy, identify methodology gaps, and derive key insights. Tackle complex data problems independently , using strong analytical judgment to refine methodologies, test new datasets, and solve challenges that require innovative thinking — even when information is incomplete or ambiguous. Use AI and tooling to drive meaningful leverage
— significantly increasing speed, reducing manual work, and beginning to automate portions of workflows. You’ll standardize best practices and build repeatable processes, always maintaining a high bar for correctness and quality while validating AI-generated outputs. Collaborate cross-functionally with Research, Engineering, and other teams
— coordinating across functions to unblock work, align on best practices, and develop technical solutions that streamline workflows, optimize data processes, and push the boundaries of automation. Identify and drive improvements to products and data pipelines , contributing ideas for new products, enhancements, and features. This could include developing new methodologies, exploring and scaling the use of new third-party datasets, or improving product profitability — all with a clear understanding of what drives value for clients.
You Are Likely To Succeed If: You have 4–5+ years of experience in data, business, or predictive analytics and are proficient in SQL, Python, and Py Spark You have a proven track record of quickly learning new concepts, particularly complex data methodologies, and building strong mental models of how and why data works You actively use AI tools (e.g., Chat GPT, Copilot, or similar) to accelerate your work and are excited about using AI to drive leverage — not just productivity, but fundamentally better and faster ways of working You can clearly communicate complex concepts — including methodology, risks, and tradeoffs — both orally and in writing You have a strong ownership mentality and are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company You can manage multiple projects simultaneously, independently prioritize tasks, and make sound decisions with incomplete information You have experience using sample or panel data to make precise estimates that guide decision-making You have a background in financial markets or are interested in learning more about data-driven investing You have an Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)
For You: Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) Flexible work schedule Personal laptop Health and wellness package Remote work
We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.
Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Lead product designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead product designer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Who are we? Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life.
Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing.
About the role This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs.
You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here.
Key responsibilities Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.
Must haves 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate
why
a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.
Nice to have Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar). Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; Java Script a plus. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

title: Regional study director, latam
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Regional study director, latam em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Crinetics is a pharmaceutical company headquartered in San Diego, California, with a growing presence in Latin America, including an office in Brazil. We are developing much-needed therapies for people with endocrine diseases and endocrine-related tumors. We were founded by a dedicated team of scientists with the simple belief that better therapies developed from rigorous innovation can lead to better lives. Our work continues to make a real difference in the lives of patients. We have a prolific discovery engine and a robust preclinical and clinical development pipeline. We are driven by science with a patient-centric and team-oriented culture. Crinetics is known for its inclusive workplace culture. This is an exciting time to join Crinetics as we expand our operations in Latin America and shape our organization into the world’s premier fully integrated endocrine company from discovery to patients. Join our team as we transform the lives of others.
Position Summary: Please note, the candidate for this role will need to be located in Brazil. The Regional Study Director, LATAM is responsible for managing the execution of clinical studies and data collection within the LATAM region. The incumbent will serve as a regional clinical study lead who oversees the review, monitoring, and adherence to clinical protocols, as well as managing and building relationships with clinical sites in LATAM. The Regional Study Director, LATAM may oversee other regional study leads within the region to facilitate a streamlined and quality study execution. This role will also work internally and externally with members of the cross-functional study team.
Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities: These may include but are not limited to: Provide oversight of clinical research studies for LATAM. Manage and build relationships with clinical research sites in LATAM. May oversee the work of other regional study leads within LATAM. Provide operational and strategic input into study documents such as synopsis, protocol, ICF, CRFs, CRF Completion Guidelines, Study Execution Plans, Clinical Data Review Plan, Clinical Database edit specifications, Clinical Study Report (CSR) development, etc. Oversight of all regional vendors and activities including CROs. Oversee regional start up activities including site selection, enrollment projections and activities driving site activation. Develop region specific the subject recruitment/retention strategy and related initiatives. Oversight of regional TMF ongoing quality review, and final reconciliation of study documents including review of site regulatory documents/packages and obtaining of appropriate site insurance, and/or supervision of team members performing these activities. Development of training materials for study team, investigational sites, and vendors. Proactive management of information sharing with key stakeholders using standardized reports and other mechanisms. Assure clinical studies are compliant with GDPR, ICH/GCP and other regulations as appropriate. Outline regional activation hurdles for team. Participate in RFP development and prepare bid templates to facilitate selection of the CROs/vendors, and/or collaboration/supervision with team members performing these activities. Collaborate with counsel to negotiate and draft research contracts and agreements with CROs/vendors and clinical study sites, as needed. Acts as liaison with Regulatory Affairs to assure adherence to GDPR, GCPs; maintenance of SOPs; and assure site and CRO/vendor audits are completed. Perform regional risk management and implement mitigations. Identify potential study issues and recommend and implement solutions or corrective actions as needed. Create realistic plans that clearly define goals, milestones, responsibilities, and results. Maintain focus on strategic objectives while accomplishing operational goals. Make timely, data-driven decisions. Manage daily activities, assign tasks, goals, and development of direct reports. Other duties as assigned.
Required Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in scientific discipline. An equivalent combination of relevant education and applicable job experience may be considered. 12 years of prior clinical operations experience preferably with CRO/small biotech experience and approximately 8 years of experience in a supervisory role. Must be able to travel 25-50% of time, may be higher in accordance with project requirements. Computer skills should include proficiency with Microsoft Office suite of software, electronic TMF systems, IXRS and EDC systems. Excellent understanding of drug development process. Experience in clinical trial supply management. Able to make appropriate decisions to move the project(s) forward. Effective verbal and written communication skills. Data flow from sites to data processing, review, and resolution. Analysis and report generation. Knowledge of local regulatory requirements. Ability to handle multiple tasks to meet deadlines in a dynamic environment is essential. Study initiation procedures. Ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action

title: Customer success manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer success manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Employment Type:
Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2 B)
About Sisense Sisense is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (An Paa S) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology.
With the recent launch of Sisense Intelligence and the Intelligence Assistant, we are accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences that bridge insights to real-time action.
The Role As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts. You will build deep relationships, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, maximize value, and fuel retention and expansion. You will collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication and proactive guidance.
Why Join Our Customer Success Team This is a strategic, high-impact role where you will own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption). You will work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to Sisense’s growth in embedded AI analytics.
About You You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused. You are a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor. You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs. You are proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities. You are collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning.
Requirements 3–5 years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (Saa S/BI/analytics preferred). Strong track record driving product adoption, value realization, NRR, and revenue expansion. Excellent presentation and executive communication skills; experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships. Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio. Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI. Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions. Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps. Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required; Portuguese a plus). Results-driven with critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus. Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment managing multiple priorities. Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/Gen AI enablement, or similar technical solutions.
How You’ll Ramp By Day 30 Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (Sisense values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes). Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value. By Day 60 Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals). Deepen product/technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work. Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side-by-side with the team. title: English teacher
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para English teacher em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you! Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.
If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.
What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire? You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!
In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:
Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.
Minimum Requirements:
Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

title: Full stack engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full stack engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About Freight Hero Freight Hero is an AI-native services company built to support the freight brokerage industry, which is in dire need of it. Robin, our autonomous AI agent, handles back-office work end to end. Our Heroes, a sharp human-in-the-loop team, catch the edge cases. Brokers pay us per load, see ROI in weeks, and reassign or eliminate the teams they used to rent.
We are backed by incredible investors, including Andrew Ng's AI Fund and supply chain specialists Dynamo Ventures.
The thesis is proven. What is next is growth, and that means building a team of incredible people around us to push the company to the next level. The product is real, the customers are real, the revenue is real, and joining now means shaping how this company runs.
About the Role This is a senior full‑stack engineering role focused on building and scaling the core Freight Hero platform. You will work across backend services, integrations, internal tools, and customer-facing features, primarily using Node.js, Type Script, React, and AWS. You won’t be inheriting a legacy monolith. You’ll be contributing to a modern, event‑driven, AI‑powered system and helping us scale it as customer adoption accelerates. You’ll collaborate closely with product, AI, and customer teams to translate real operational workflows into robust, reliable software. As the team grows, you’ll have opportunities to mentor others, influence architecture, and shape engineering best practices.
What Success Looks Like A successful engineer in this role: Builds scalable, reliable services in Node.js/Type Script that integrate deeply with customer systems. Designs and maintains AWS‑native
infrastructure that is observable, secure, and cost‑efficient. Works cross‑functionally to understand customer workflows and translate them into technical solutions. Ships high‑quality features quickly while maintaining engineering excellence. Identifies opportunities to automate, optimize, and expand the platform. Contributes to a culture of ownership, clarity, and continuous improvement.
Key Responsibilities:
Full Stack Engineering Build backend services, APIs, and workflow engines using Node.js + Type Script. Contribute to frontend components when needed using React + Vue JS. Implement robust testing, observability, and CI/CD practices.
AWS native Architecture Design and maintain cloud infrastructure using AWS services such as Lambda, RDS, Dynamo DB, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, and more. Ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost‑optimized.
Systems Integration Build integrations with TMS platforms, carrier systems, and customer‑specific tools. Work with internal teams to understand operational processes and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
AI Forward Development Collaborate with AI engineers to embed LLM‑powered workflows into the product. Use AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and automate repetitive tasks. Identify opportunities to expand AI‑driven automation across the platform.
Collaboration & Impact Work closely with product, operations, and customer success to deeply understand customer needs. Participate in technical discussions, architectural decisions, and roadmap planning. Help establish engineering best practices as the team grows.
What We Are Looking For 8+ years of professional software engineering experience. Strong expertise in Node.js, Type Script, React, and AWS cloud architecture. Experience building distributed systems, event‑driven architectures, or workflow automation. Comfortable working across the stack (backend‑heavy, but able to contribute to frontend). Strong communicator who collaborates well with non‑technical teams. High ownership mindset - you thrive in fast‑moving, ambiguous environments. Curiosity about AI and eagerness to leverage it in your day‑to‑day work. Bonus: experience in freight tech, logistics, or integrations with TMS/ERP systems.
Why Freight Hero Built at the intersection of AI and logistics, one of the most impactful spaces in B2 B tech. Work with a team that moves fast, thinks big, and cares deeply about customer outcomes. Opportunities to mentor, influence architecture, and grow as the engineering team scales. Competitive compensation with performance incentives. Fully remote with a collaborative, high‑performance culture.

exclusiva

.

Você será parte de
uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas

não é uma vaga CLT

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a
ii
com certeza é o seu lugar.
Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.
Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Data product associate
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data product associate em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About Yipit Data: Yipit Data is the market-leading data and analytics firm. We analyze billions of data points every day to provide accurate, detailed insights across industries, including consumer brands, technology, software, and healthcare. Our insights team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean, and analyze the data that many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend on. We raised $475 M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation over $1 B, further accelerating our growth and market impact. We have been recognized multiple times as one of Inc’s Best Workplaces. As a fast-growing company backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners, Yipit Data is driven by a people-first culture rooted in mastery, ownership, and transparency. With offices in New York, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore, we continue to expand our reach and impact across global markets.
About the Role: We currently have 60+ Data team members in our Investor business who build, create and maintain our data products, and we are looking to further expand the team to continue to increase our product portfolio. Those with strong analytical skills who are passionate about data and excited to scale quickly to deliver top-tier products to our clients are encouraged to apply. At Yipit Data, we value ownership and impact. Your growth is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at Yipit Data is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Our career ladder also rewards strong performance with regular opportunities for compensation increases and promotions. See this short video
to learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current data team members love working here!
As a Data Associate, you will: Own high-impact data products end-to-end
— driving product success by delivering best-in-class outputs with a focus on accuracy, client value, and efficiency. You’ll ramp quickly into full ownership of your products and workflows, operating with minimal oversight. Work with massive amounts of data
to answer our clients’ key questions about the companies and datasets we analyze. You’ll develop deep expertise in our proprietary methods and techniques, building strong mental models that allow you to ensure data accuracy, identify methodology gaps, and derive key insights. Tackle complex data problems independently , using strong analytical judgment to refine methodologies, test new datasets, and solve challenges that require innovative thinking — even when information is incomplete or ambiguous. Use AI and tooling to drive meaningful leverage
— significantly increasing speed, reducing manual work, and beginning to automate portions of workflows. You’ll standardize best practices and build repeatable processes, always maintaining a high bar for correctness and quality while validating AI-generated outputs. Collaborate cross-functionally with Research, Engineering, and other teams
— coordinating across functions to unblock work, align on best practices, and develop technical solutions that streamline workflows, optimize data processes, and push the boundaries of automation. Identify and drive improvements to products and data pipelines , contributing ideas for new products, enhancements, and features. This could include developing new methodologies, exploring and scaling the use of new third-party datasets, or improving product profitability — all with a clear understanding of what drives value for clients.
You Are Likely To Succeed If: You have 4–5+ years of experience in data, business, or predictive analytics and are proficient in SQL, Python, and Py Spark You have a proven track record of quickly learning new concepts, particularly complex data methodologies, and building strong mental models of how and why data works You actively use AI tools (e.g., Chat GPT, Copilot, or similar) to accelerate your work and are excited about using AI to drive leverage — not just productivity, but fundamentally better and faster ways of working You can clearly communicate complex concepts — including methodology, risks, and tradeoffs — both orally and in writing You have a strong ownership mentality and are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company You can manage multiple projects simultaneously, independently prioritize tasks, and make sound decisions with incomplete information You have experience using sample or panel data to make precise estimates that guide decision-making You have a background in financial markets or are interested in learning more about data-driven investing You have an Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)
For You: Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) Flexible work schedule Personal laptop Health and wellness package Remote work
We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.
Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Global ta manager (contractor role)
description:

Base Rate + Performance-Based Placement Bonus (Earn extra for every successful hire!)
Role Overview We are stripping away the corporate red tape. This role is built for one thing and one thing only:
Pure, High-Velocity Recruitment Delivery. As a Global TA Manager, you will focus entirely on the frontlines of our international experienced hiring tracks (spanning R&D, Product, and Growth) across the U. S., Europe, LATAM, and Asia. You will be the bridging force between global talent and our HQ team. If you are an independent recruiter who prides yourself on speed, market-mapping accuracy, and closing deals, this is your playground.
What You Will Do- High-Volume Sourcing & Delivery:
Own the end-to-end sourcing and pipeline management for mid-to-senior global roles. You will hunt via Linked In, regional job boards, Git Hub, and cold-outreach to keep our pipelines buzzing. HQ & Candidate Facilitation:
Screen global talent, pitch our vision, and seamlessly manage candidates through the interview process, acting as the primary point of contact. Data & Pipeline Transparency:
Keep candidate trackers clean and updated, ensuring our global talent pipelines are accurate and moving fast.
The DNA We Are Looking For- The Baseline (Hard Skills): Bilingual Mastery (English & Chinese):
Both English and Mandarin Chinese must be your fluent working languages.
You can interview global talent in flawless English and align instantly with our HQ hiring managers in Chinese. Proven Recruitment Engine:
2-4+ years of recruiting experience in tech, internet, or global expansion enterprises. A proven track record of delivering cross-border talent is a massive plus. Geographic Flexibility:
Based in Indonesia, Vietnam, or the U. S., with deep roots in local talent networks but a completely global mindset.
Core Traits (Soft Skills): The \"Bias for Action\" Delivery Machine:
You are fiercely result-oriented, self-driven, and hyper-focused on closing roles. You think on your feet and get things done without waiting for instructions. Insatiable Curiosity & No Guardrails:
You don't get trapped by fixed processes. You are eager to experiment with new sourcing hacks, leverage AI tools, and test bold outreach strategies to find that needle in a haystack.
What You Will Get & The Challenges You Will Face What You Will Get: Uncapped Earning Potential:
On top of your base rate, we offer a highly competitive, milestone-based placement bonus layout. The faster and more effectively you deliver, the more you earn. The Global Flex-Work Playbook:
Get hands-on, practical experience inside a highly progressive global flexible-staffing ecosystem. You'll see exactly how a top-tier global tech brand runs an agile, remote talent network. A Trusted Extension of the Crew:
No micromanagement. You enjoy the ultimate flexibility of a remote setup while having a world-class global TA team supporting you from behind.
The Challenges You Will Face: 100% Remote Coordination:
Working across time zones requires you to be hyper-proactive. You must be comfortable with asynchronous communication and managing your own energy and schedule. Embracing Ambiguity:
Global talent markets move fast and change constantly. You need to be comfortable adjusting your sourcing strategy on the fly when a business need shifts.

title: Médico nefrologista em telemedicina (com rqe)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico nefrologista em telemedicina (com rqe) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. *
OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO NEFROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"
Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!
A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em
Nefrologia!
Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.
*
SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:
* A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.
*
O QUE PROCURAMOS:
*
Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de
Nefrologia
, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.
*PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*
Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Nefrologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.
Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.
Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.
Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.
Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.
Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.
Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças nefrológicas.
Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.
Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.
Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.
Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Nefrologia.
Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.
Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.
Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.
Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.
Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.
Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.
Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.
REQUISITOS
Formação Acadêmica: Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM NEFROLOGIA.
Certificações: Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista em Nefrologia - RQE
(Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado); Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);
Experiência: Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Nefrologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina.

title: Full stack engineer
description:

About Freight Hero Freight Hero is an AI-native services company built to support the freight brokerage industry, which is in dire need of it. Robin, our autonomous AI agent, handles back-office work end to end. Our Heroes, a sharp human-in-the-loop team, catch the edge cases. We are backed by incredible investors, including Andrew Ng's AI Fund and supply chain specialists Dynamo Ventures.
The thesis is proven. What is next is growth, and that means building a team of incredible people around us to push the company to the next level. The product is real, the customers are real, the revenue is real, and joining now means shaping how this company runs.
About the Role This is a senior full‑stack engineering role focused on building and scaling the core Freight Hero platform. You will work across backend services, integrations, internal tools, and customer-facing features, primarily using Node.js, Type Script, React, and AWS. You won’t be inheriting a legacy monolith. You’ll be contributing to a modern, event‑driven, AI‑powered system and helping us scale it as customer adoption accelerates. You’ll collaborate closely with product, AI, and customer teams to translate real operational workflows into robust, reliable software. As the team grows, you’ll have opportunities to mentor others, influence architecture, and shape engineering best practices.
What Success Looks Like A successful engineer in this role: Builds scalable, reliable services in Node.js/Type Script that integrate deeply with customer systems. Designs and maintains AWS‑native
infrastructure that is observable, secure, and cost‑efficient. Works cross‑functionally to understand customer workflows and translate them into technical solutions. Ships high‑quality features quickly while maintaining engineering excellence. Identifies opportunities to automate, optimize, and expand the platform. Contributes to a culture of ownership, clarity, and continuous improvement.
Key Responsibilities:
Full Stack Engineering Build backend services, APIs, and workflow engines using Node.js + Type Script. Contribute to frontend components when needed using React + Vue JS. Implement robust testing, observability, and CI/CD practices.
AWS native Architecture Design and maintain cloud infrastructure using AWS services such as Lambda, RDS, Dynamo DB, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, and more. Ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost‑optimized.
Systems Integration Build integrations with TMS platforms, carrier systems, and customer‑specific tools. Work with internal teams to understand operational processes and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
AI Forward Development Collaborate with AI engineers to embed LLM‑powered workflows into the product. Use AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and automate repetitive tasks. Identify opportunities to expand AI‑driven automation across the platform.
Collaboration & Impact Work closely with product, operations, and customer success to deeply understand customer needs. Participate in technical discussions, architectural decisions, and roadmap planning. Help establish engineering best practices as the team grows.
What We Are Looking For 8+ years of professional software engineering experience. Strong expertise in Node.js, Type Script, React, and AWS cloud architecture. Experience building distributed systems, event‑driven architectures, or workflow automation. Comfortable working across the stack (backend‑heavy, but able to contribute to frontend). Strong communicator who collaborates well with non‑technical teams. High ownership mindset - you thrive in fast‑moving, ambiguous environments. Curiosity about AI and eagerness to leverage it in your day‑to‑day work. Bonus: experience in freight tech, logistics, or integrations with TMS/ERP systems.
Why Freight Hero Built at the intersection of AI and logistics, one of the most impactful spaces in B2 B tech. Work with a team that moves fast, thinks big, and cares deeply about customer outcomes. Opportunities to mentor, influence architecture, and grow as the engineering team scales. Competitive compensation with performance incentives. Fully remote with a collaborative, high‑performance culture.

Comercialmente, cuidamos das lavouras e da produção animal em todos os estados brasileiros através da maior e mais qualificada equipe técnica a campo do Brasil.

Como ANALISTA PROCESSOS P&D você vai ser responsável por:

Executa os processos industriais visando acompanhamento e melhoria dos mesmos e da qualidade do produto final obtido, coletando amostras em escala industrial e fazendo análises destas amostras. Executa a realização de testes, pesquisas e simulações em planta piloto e em escala industrial, objetivando o desenvolvimento de novos produtos, para melhorias de processos e redução de custos em função de alternativas de uso de matérias primas, aumento de produtividade e melhoria na qualidade dos produtos. Realização de testes de estabilidade de novas formulações de sólidos e líquidos e produção de amostras para testes. Produção e análise de amostras para registro na América Latina. Realiza monitoramento e controle do processo produtivo em todas as áreas produtivas (NPK, SOP e ensaque). Executa treinamentos de processos com os operadores de carregamento e de produção. Realiza acompanhamento na qualidade dos produtos durante a produção e carregamento com senso crítico, propondo e executando ações para solução dos problemas. Executa a análise de águas (dureza, índice de fósfatos, sulfato, cloretos, sólidos e disperso, alcalinidade, PH, etc.), análise de produtos, análise de superfosfato, análise de matéria- prima, análise de misturas e análise de micro e macro nutrientes, obedecendo a critérios técnicos e fazendo o registro dos resultados no sistema. Analisa os produtos oriundos de reclamações de clientes, através de estudos de condições de uso do produto para subsidiar parecer sobre a procedência da demanda. Efetua suporte aos demais analistas de laboratório quando necessário, Gestão e análise de RRCs.

EVP: Conectar pessoas e talentos, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e de desenvolvimento contínuo, gerando resultados sustentáveis e impactando positivamente aeroportos, clientes, passageiros e a sociedade.

title: Analista de controle de investimentos júnior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de controle de investimentos júnior em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Missão do Cargo: 

Assegurar o acompanhamento e qualidade das informações dos investimentos financeiros e imobiliários, contribuindo para a tomada de decisão, a conformidade regulatória, a governança e a geração de valor sustentável para a entidade.

Responsabilidade e Tarefas: 

Executar o acompanhamento, controle e análise das carteiras de investimentos, assegurando a consistência das informações econômico-financeiras.

Elaborar relatórios gerenciais periódicos de desempenho, rentabilidade dos investimentos, em conformidade com a Política de Investimentos, normativos internos e legislação vigente.

Efetuar conciliações de posições, fluxos financeiros e rentabilidades entre sistemas internos, custodiante, administradores e gestores de recursos.

Acompanhar indicadores macroeconômicos e financeiro impactam a carteira de investimentos dos planos e perfis.

Realizar o controle, acompanhamento e atualização das informações relativas aos imóveis próprios e investimentos imobiliários.

Acompanhar contratos imobiliários (locação, cessão, notas fiscais, compra e venda), analisando prazos, reajustes e riscos associados.

Apoiar a análise de laudos de avaliação imobiliária, estudos de viabilidade e documentos técnicos relacionados aos ativos.

Consolidar e analisar informações sobre receitas e despesas imobiliárias, taxas de ocupação, rentabilidade e desempenho econômico dos imóveis.

Apoiar a elaboração de informações e relatórios destinados à Diretoria, Conselhos, Comitês de Investimentos e órgãos reguladores.

Atuar no suporte a auditorias internas e externas, organizando informações, documentos e evidências dos processos sob responsabilidade da Gerência.

Propor melhorias em rotinas operacionais, automatizações e padronizações de controles e relatórios.

Realizar outras atividades que tenham relação com o cargo.

Formação:  Ensino Superior Completo em Administração, Economia, Contabilidade e áreas afins. 
Aceitável: Cursando ultimo semestre.

Experiência: Recém formado e/ou experiência de pelo menos 1 ano na área ou função similar.

Certificados e Treinamentos:  Conhecimentos avançados de informática (Pacote Office). Certificação - Mínimo CPA-20 (ANBIMA)

Competências: Cumprimento a Métodos e Processos Operacionais; Matemática Financeira; Controle e análise de informações; Elaboração e análise de relatórios; Bom domínio de Excel e planilhas gerenciais (fórmulas, tabelas dinâmicas, controles); Organização e gestão de prazos; Trabalho em Equipe; Comunicação; Proatividade.

Benefícios:  VR/VA: R$ 1.940,71; Day-off de aniversário; Sexta-feira curta (6 horas); Remuneração variável: até 30% da remuneração bruta anual; Plano de saúde e odontológico sem custo para empregado e dependentes; Seguro de vida em grupo; Auxílio Atividade Física: R$ 237,13; Previdência Privada(100%); Auxílio Educação; Horário flexível e outros.

Jornada: 40 horas semanais, segunda à sexta.

Obs.:  Regime de trabalho presencial, Salvador-BA.

title: Engenheiro de custos senior - real estate - camaçari/bahia
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de custos senior - real estate - camaçari/bahia em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da empresa

A Turner & Townsend é uma empresa global de serviços profissionais com mais de colaboradores em mais de 60 países. Trabalhando com nossos clientes nos setores de imobiliário, infraestrutura, energia e recursos naturais, transformamos juntos, entregando resultados que melhoram a vida das pessoas.

Trabalhamos em parceria e tornamos possível entregas dos projetos e programas mais impactantes do mundo, transformando desafios em oportunidades e complexidade em sucesso.

Nossos serviços incluem Gestão de Programas, Projetos, Custos, Ativos e Comercial, Controles e Desempenho, Compras e Cadeia de suprimentos, soluções para emissões zero e Digital.

Somos majoritariamente de propriedade do CBRE Group, Inc., a maior empresa de serviços imobiliários comerciais e investimentos do mundo, com nossos parceiros detendo uma participação minoritária significativa. Turner & Townsend e CBRE trabalham juntos para fornecer aos clientes a melhor oferta de gestão de programas, projetos e custos em mercados ao redor do mundo.

Descrição da vaga

The Senior Cost Manager will take responsibility for effectively delivering a range of tasks to high quality standard and aid on a wide range of projects of all sizes and dimensions.

The professional will report to a Cost Management Associate Director and will be responsible for commercial aspects of projects in several sectors, supporting with budget management, project cost control, estimation, procurement, and change control during execution.

Candidates should preferably have experience in the Real Estate  sector.

Responsibilities

Included but not limited to: Drive cost estimates according to all design phases, aligned with AACE RPs. Monitor and control contracts (measurement, claims, penalties, etc.). Lead value engineering sessions. Prepare and analyze change orders. Develop progress measurement criteria with vendors. Collect cost market data. Lead procurement processes. Produce cash flow forecasts for internal and client purposes. Support on reviewing project budget after design packages issuance by the technical team. Collaborate with the creation of the recommendation report. Participate in the weekly project and departmental meetings. Issue weekly progress reports on project costs including forecasting reimbursable expenses. Support on stakeholder management.

Qualificações Degree-qualified or equivalent in Engineering or Architecture. Solid experience working in similar role pre and post contract. Complete project ownership. Knowledge in Cost Control, Cost Estimate, Change Orders and Cost Management arerequired. Knowledge and understanding of the component parts of a project and overall construction costs. Ability to analyze and interpret commercial and technical project documentation. Commercial awareness and understanding of the Construction process. Excellent communication skills, both oral & written. Negotiation skills and ability to apply those skills internally, externally & with our supply chain. Positive attitude always and the ability to integrate and play an active part in the Project Team Good organizational skills and the ability to priorities to meet deadlines. Keen to pursue personal development needs and keep up to date knowledge. Advanced experience with the MS Office Package (Project, Word, Excel, and Power Point) and MS Project. Knowledge and skills with Power BI are a plus. Fluent in English. Spanish is a plus.

Informações adicionais

Nossos profissionais inspirados compartilham nossa visão e missão. Oferecemos um excelente local de trabalho, onde cada pessoa tem a oportunidade e a voz para promover mudanças.

Queremos que nossos profissionais tenham sucesso tanto no trabalho quanto na vida pessoal e por isso promovemos um ambiente de trabalho saudável, produtivo e flexível que respeita o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional.

A Turner & Townsend é um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades. Celebramos a diversidade e estamos comprometidos em criar um ambiente inclusivo para todos os funcionários, incentivando ativamente candidaturas de todos os setores da comunidade.

description:

Diferenciais
Pós-graduação em Direito Tributário, Gestão Fiscal ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência com DCTF e EFD-Reinf.

title: EstÁgio - financeiro
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para EstÁgio - financeiro em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

JOB DESCRIPTION

A Engepack é pioneira na fabricação de embalagens PET no país, 100% brasileira, e possui a maior e mais moderna fábrica de preformas PET do país.

Todo esse pioneirismo está associado a um alinhamento com as questões super atuais de sustentabilidade, meio ambiente e responsabilidade social . Resultado disso foi o recente projeto ultra inovador para a região, com a implantação de uma Unidade de Reciclagem do PET , com capacidade para transformar 50% das embalagens PET descartadas no Estado da Bahia em uma nova garrafa, garantindo o fechamento do ciclo de uma economia circular, retirando mais de 1 bilhão de garrafas PET descartadas do meio ambiente por ano.

A alta capacitação técnica e a experiência acumulada de nossos colaboradores consegue entregar soluções competitivas e inovadoras para os maiores clientes de bebidas no país. Temos uma especial atenção na produção para atender as indústrias de alimentos e bebidas, que embalam produtos como refrigerantes, águas, sucos, chás, lácteos, óleos comestíveis, maionese e etc., contudo a aplicação de nossa embalagem vai além, sendo a solução ideal para produtos domissanitários, cosméticos e farmacêuticos, o que nos faz presente no consumo diário de milhões de brasileiros .

No nosso setor financeiro, o estudante terá a oportunidade de vivenciar o cotidiano de uma tesouraria  de indústria de grande porte, aprendendo e participando da gestão do caixa, recebíveis, contas a pagar, câmbio, aplicações financeiras e captações em dólar e linhas de financiamento nacionais . Participará das interações da empresa com as instituições do mercado financeiro, mercado securitário, auditoria e órgãos governamentais .

Esse estágio tem o potencial ILIMITADO  de transformar você em um profissional apto para atuar em qualquer área financeira  de qualquer empresa de grande porte , lhe dando propriedade e repertório operacional e gerencial para que leve consigo para onde quer que for.

Se você é uma pessoa analítica , organizada , com pensamento crítico  e aguçada no raciocínio lógico , que se interessa pelo universo financeiro em grandes corporações , essa é a vaga certa para você !

RESPONSIBILITIES AND ASSIGNMENTS

1. Atualização de controles no contas a receber e a pagar;

2. Acompanhamento de títulos do contas a receber com diálogo recorrente com clientes;

3. Apoio nas rotinas de cobrança escritural, lidando com instituições bancárias e sistemas relacionados;

4. Apoio nas rotinas de Aplicação Financeira, Gestão do Caixa, Projeção do Fluxo de Caixa, e controles associados;

5. Apoio no relacionamento com instituições financeiras e mercado securitário;

6. Atualização dos controles de empréstimos, fianças e apólices de seguro.

REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS Cursando Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis, Matemática, Estatística ou Engenharia; Possuir conhecimento intermediário em Excel; Possuir conhecimento em Power BI será considerado um diferencial; Possuir noções básicas sobre o mercado financeiro; Perfil hands-on

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

Regime de trabalho: Modelo híbrido, com atuação presencial no escritório corporativo 4 dias por semana e 1 dia em home office.

Local de trabalho: Escritório Corporativo localizado no bairro Caminho das Árvores, em Salvador/BA.

Plano de Saúde

Vale-alimentação ou Vale-refeição

Auxílio Transporte Flexível

  Total Pass

Somos Engepack

Somos a Engepack

Trabalhar na Engepack é fazer parte de uma equipe que acredita em pessoas, em propósito e em crescimento conjunto. Aqui, valorizamos quem faz acontecer todos os dias, com comprometimento, colaboração e vontade de ir além .

Somos uma empresa que atua com destaque no setor de embalagens plásticas, referência em soluções em PET para os principais clientes do mercado. Produzimos preformas em PET , que dão forma e proteção a produtos de grandes marcas em todo o Brasil, na nossa fábrica de injeção plástica. E produzimos resinas a partir de um processo de reciclagem , na nossa fábrica de Resina Reciclada.

Mas o que realmente nos diferencia são as pessoas que constroem essa história com dedicação e orgulho. Na Engepack, cada conquista é fruto do trabalho em equipe e da paixão por entregar qualidade.

Juntos, crescemos, aprendemos e celebramos.
